questions.q: In 'The Wolf and the Ass', why did the Ass pretend to be lame?
choices: To trick the Wolf so he could escape
To get out of work
To make the farmer feel sorry for him
Because he really had a thorn in his foot
questions.evidence: thought of a plan to save himself. So he pretended he was lame

questions.q: In 'The Wolf and the Ass', what happened while the Wolf looked for the thorn?
choices: The Ass kicked him and ran away
The Wolf found the thorn and pulled it out
The farmer came and chased the Wolf
The Ass fell asleep
questions.evidence: Just then the Ass kicked out with all his might

questions.q: What is the lesson of 'The Wolf and the Ass'?
choices: Stick to your trade
Always help those who are hurt
Thorns are dangerous
Never eat when you are in a hurry

questions.q: In 'The Monkey and the Cat', what happened each time the Cat pulled a chestnut from the fire?
choices: The Monkey ate it up
She ate it herself
She saved it for the master
She dropped it in the cinders
questions.evidence: As fast as she pulled the chestnuts out of the fire, the Monkey ate them up.

questions.q: What is the lesson of 'The Monkey and the Cat'?
choices: A flatterer wants something from you at your cost
Chestnuts are best when roasted
Friends should always share
Never play near a fire
questions.evidence: The flatterer seeks some benefit at your expense.

questions.q: In 'The Dogs and the Fox', what were the Dogs tearing with their teeth?
choices: The skin of a dead Lion
A sleeping Lion
A piece of meat
An old blanket
questions.evidence: Some Dogs found the skin of a Lion

questions.q: In 'The Dogs and the Hides', how did the Dogs try to reach the hides?
choices: By drinking up the river
By diving to the bottom
By building a dam
By asking the Tanner for help
questions.evidence: decided that the very best thing to do was to drink up the river

questions.q: In 'The Rabbit, the Weasel, and the Cat', why did the Cat tell them to come close?
choices: So she could catch them both
Because she really was deaf
So she could whisper a secret
So they could all share the house
questions.evidence: in an instant the Cat had them both under her claws

questions.q: In 'The Rabbit, the Weasel, and the Cat', how did the Weasel get into the Rabbit's house?
choices: The Rabbit forgot to latch the door
He dug a new tunnel
The Cat let him in
The Rabbit invited him to dinner
questions.evidence: he forgot to latch the door of his house
